requirement: Each model shall retain units, assumptions, source-tool/version information, and known conversion or solver limitations.
verification_acceptance: I/T: these fields survive save/reopen and appear in diagnostic reports.

requirement: Numerical and compatibility comparison tolerances shall be specified before regression runs and versioned independently of results.
verification_acceptance: I/T: changing a tolerance marks previous pass/fail results for reassessment.

requirement: Each release requirement shall link to its implementation test or demonstration and any known defect affecting it.
verification_acceptance: I: claimed compatibility features have reproducible test results.

requirement: Workbench and owned C++ engine shall be open source; ordinary modeling and native solving shall require no proprietary CAD runtime.
verification_acceptance: I/D: clean offline installation opens, creates, and solves a native project.

requirement: GUI, CLI, and MCP shall call the same versioned application operations and enforce the same model invariants.
verification_acceptance: T: equivalent operation sequences produce identical canonical model hashes.

requirement: The independent numerical engine shall run without FreeCAD or a Python interpreter installed, using immutable typed model snapshots.
verification_acceptance: T: headless native reference suite on an engine-only installation.

requirement: FreeCAD document and GUI mutations shall occur on the owning application thread; long work shall execute asynchronously.
verification_acceptance: T: cancellation, concurrent viewing, and worker completion do not corrupt a document.

requirement: IPC shall pass values, identifiers, and artifact references rather than FreeCAD/C++ object pointers.
verification_acceptance: I/T: schema validation and restart/replay tests.

requirement: Adapter, solver, project schema, and application API versions shall be negotiated and recorded; incompatible major versions shall fail explicitly.
verification_acceptance: T: version mismatch returns an actionable diagnostic before mutation.

requirement: The FCST CPU reference implementation shall run without a GPU; accelerated owned-engine backends shall pass independent equivalence tests.
verification_acceptance: T: supported-platform native suite; GPU implementation separately listed if shipped.

requirement: Job crashes shall be isolated from FreeCAD and leave the last committed project revision recoverable.
verification_acceptance: T: terminate workers during import, radiation, solve, and export.

requirement: The primary production solver shall be an independently maintained C++ engine owning thermal model assembly, physics semantics, steady/transient solution orchestration, and result diagnostics.
verification_acceptance: I/T: required core fixtures solve with external thermal solvers absent; another language requires the documented Q0 decision process.

requirement: Adopted open-source solver code/components shall have recorded provenance, compatible licensing, maintainable interfaces, and independent regression tests.
verification_acceptance: I/T: component inventory identifies retained/reworked code and its tests; no unsupported ownership or licensing claim.

requirement: PyCanha and other external thermal solvers shall be optional reference/prototype backends; their successful runs shall not count as owned-engine acceptance results.
verification_acceptance: T/I: run records identify the actual backend and gate evaluation rejects substituted external runs.

requirement: Canonical models, UI commands, and MCP operations shall remain backend-independent while exposing the actual solver identity and capabilities.
verification_acceptance: T: a reference backend can be removed without changing the native model format or mislabeling results.

requirement: Before numerical interfaces freeze, the project shall record a prototype-based C++ suitability assessment and, when testing Rust as a challenger, use the same snapshots, numerical backend, tolerances, hardware and comparison criteria.
verification_acceptance: T/A: correctness, convergence, event/energy error, runtime, memory, implementation effort and Windows packaging evidence recorded; C++ remains the default unless an explicit decision changes it.

requirement: Low-level numerical and ray-intersection dependencies shall sit behind owned-engine interfaces and shall not replace FCST thermal/radiation model semantics or acceptance tests.
verification_acceptance: I/T: dependency versions, capabilities and licenses recorded; native analytic/source-comparison cases pass.

requirement: Python shall provide FreeCAD integration and automation/test orchestration while the compiled engine owns repeated performance-critical physics kernels.
verification_acceptance: T/I: engine-only operation and Python GUI/CLI/MCP tests agree; profile representative workloads before moving additional code across the boundary.

requirement: Every entity shall have a persistent UUID; legacy tool/version, entity handle, submodel, and node number shall be separate mapped identifiers.
verification_acceptance: T: duplicate source IDs across submodels import without collisions and export consistently.

requirement: CAD geometry, radiation tessellation, conduction mesh, and thermal topology shall be distinct with explicit many-to-many mappings.
verification_acceptance: T: a multi-node shell and geometry-free network both solve and round-trip.

requirement: Dimensional values shall have quantity types; internal computation shall use SI and absolute kelvin for radiative laws.
verification_acceptance: T: offset-temperature, imperial, and mixed-unit fixtures agree after conversion.

requirement: Coordinate frames shall record units, handedness, transforms, epoch/time scale where applicable, and tensor orientation.
verification_acceptance: T: rotated anisotropic and articulated fixtures preserve physical behavior.

requirement: Face indices alone shall not identify thermal attachments; links shall include persistent references, signatures, mapping state, and source revision.
verification_acceptance: T: face split, merge, deletion, and reordering never silently reassign coatings or heaters.

requirement: Input changes shall invalidate affected meshes, radiation data, solutions, and acceptance records through a dependency graph.
verification_acceptance: T: changed optics invalidates radiation; changed loads invalidates affected results.

requirement: Original imports and referenced files shall be retained byte-for-byte with hashes and dependency inventories.
verification_acceptance: T: original artifact hashes match after save/reopen and failed conversion.

requirement: Save shall be atomic; recovery and schema migration shall retain a recoverable previous revision.
verification_acceptance: T: interrupted write, old-schema migration, and downgrade-export tests.

requirement: Portable packages shall close dependencies and reject executable deserialization as a data-storage mechanism.
verification_acceptance: T/I: clean-machine reopen, path traversal, malicious archive, and payload tests.

requirement: Results shall bind to model/mesh/property/environment hashes, engine and adapter builds, settings, seeds, and execution platform.
verification_acceptance: T: stale result application fails; full provenance report reconstructs each run.

requirement: Expressions shall use a specified typed grammar and deterministic evaluation order, with dependency and cycle diagnostics.
verification_acceptance: T: unit errors, cycles, undefined symbols, and source-language differences are detected.

requirement: Native model and results schemas shall be public, versioned, and independently readable without the FreeCAD add-on.
verification_acceptance: I/T: schema fixtures validate using a separate reader.

requirement: Canonical transaction ownership, host dirty/reconciliation state, undo, semantic hashes, and coordinated package/host recovery shall follow the defined persistence contract.
verification_acceptance: T: direct host edits, failed synchronization, undo, and interrupted dual-file saves cannot produce a false clean revision.

requirement: Run metadata shall identify execution mode, actual engine build/hash, dependency/adopted-code provenance, and separate conversion-adapter identity.
verification_acceptance: T/I: fcst_native, prototype_external, reference_external, and fallback_external runs remain distinguishable; only fcst_native can close owned-engine gates.

requirement: The native engine shall solve steady and transient nonlinear thermal networks with capacitive, algebraic, and prescribed boundary nodes.
verification_acceptance: T: analytical and independent-solver benchmarks across node classes.

requirement: Materials shall support temperature-dependent density, conductivity, heat capacity, enthalpy, and symmetric positive-definite anisotropic conduction tensors in local frames.
verification_acceptance: T: interpolation limits, positivity, energy, and rotated-anisotropy cases.

requirement: Supported FD primitives and FE surface/solid elements shall assemble consistent conduction and storage terms with documented lumping/reduction options.
verification_acceptance: T/A: spatial refinement and element patch/manufactured-solution tests.

requirement: Contact conductance, convection, lumped links, distributed heat loads, heaters, and initial conditions shall have explicit units and selection mappings.
verification_acceptance: T: integrated areas/powers, contact gaps, and prescribed-boundary cases.

requirement: Heater and schedule logic shall support hysteresis, state, discontinuities, event localization, and restart state.
verification_acceptance: T: threshold crossings and event times meet approved tolerances under time-step refinement.

requirement: Nonlinear and transient solvers shall publish tolerances, residuals, convergence state, rejected steps, and termination cause.
verification_acceptance: T: singular, disconnected, and nonconvergent problems never return a success status.

requirement: Closed-system conservation and open-system boundary-power balances shall be reported per step and over the run.
verification_acceptance: T: analytic energy tests and explicit imbalance diagnostics.

requirement: Parameter sweeps, sensitivity, and uncertainty campaigns shall record distributions, correlations, bounds, seeds, and all sampled inputs.
verification_acceptance: T: deterministic replay and independent calculation of selected sensitivities.

requirement: Radiation shall support diffuse-gray surface exchange, front/back optical properties, open-space escape, groups, exclusions, and occlusion.
verification_acceptance: T: enclosure, two-sided panel, shadow, and radiation-group benchmarks.

requirement: View-factor diagnostics shall include bounds, area reciprocity, and closure with escape/environment accounted for.
verification_acceptance: T/A: analytical cases and uncertainty-aware conservation checks.

requirement: Monte Carlo calculations shall report ray counts, estimator definitions, confidence/convergence information, and reproducible seed streams.
verification_acceptance: T: convergence studies and repeated-seed replay on the reference configuration.

requirement: Solar absorptance and infrared emittance shall be distinct; optical datasets shall carry bands, temperature/range, BOL/EOL, uncertainty, and provenance.
verification_acceptance: T: optical unit/range checks and separate solar/IR reference cases.

requirement: Specular, transmissive, or wavelength-dependent behavior required by the legacy corpus shall be implemented and tested in the owned engine before claiming native support.
verification_acceptance: T: matching optical-law fixtures pass on the owned engine; an external fallback does not close missing native behavior.

requirement: Mission definitions shall include celestial body constants, epoch/time scale, orbit/trajectory, attitude, articulations, and eclipses.
verification_acceptance: T: geometry, flux, and timing comparisons against independent references.

requirement: Environmental loading shall support solar, albedo, body IR, deep-space background, and test-chamber boundaries with explicit model assumptions.
verification_acceptance: T/A: known geometries and integrated incident-power comparisons.

requirement: Time-varying radiation geometry shall invalidate or regenerate applicable exchange data with documented interpolation error controls.
verification_acceptance: T: moving-panel and eclipse/attitude transitions agree under refinement.

requirement: MLI, insulation, and heat-pipe abstractions shall declare their validity assumptions and limits rather than imply detailed physics.
verification_acceptance: I/T: parameter provenance and calibrated reduced-model reference cases.

requirement: Multiphase fluids, detailed heat pipes, and other advanced behavior required by mandatory source models shall have tested owned-engine implementations or explicitly accepted native equivalents.
verification_acceptance: T: required legacy cases pass on the owned engine; archival retention and vendor execution alone do not pass.

requirement: A controlled acquired inventory shall record source files and observed versions, file families, dependencies, features, cases, result and rights dispositions, and assigned gaps; complete source scope shall freeze before its compatibility qualification.
verification_acceptance: I: acquired TD and ESATAN examples have immutable provenance and equal-priority profile mappings; unknown versions or missing inputs have explicit owners and qualification blockers.

requirement: TD and ESATAN core profile qualification shall pass at the same Q1 gate; success in one shall not substitute for the other.
verification_acceptance: T/I: paired profile acceptance reports.

requirement: Every conversion shall produce a machine-readable feature inventory and fidelity report per entity/case, operation, and version profile with source and target IDs.
verification_acceptance: T: complete inventories for positive, partial, and malformed fixtures; execution does not imply edit/write support.

requirement: Retained-opaque, approximated, and unsupported statuses shall remain distinct from executable compatibility.
verification_acceptance: T: opaque code cannot satisfy a solver/profile release check.

requirement: TD source-project import and export shall preserve thermal semantics through independent file codecs without TD, OpenTD, AutoCAD/CRTechCAD, SINDA/FLUINT, vendor licenses, prior vendor conversion or vendor services; generic geometry import shall be labeled geometry-only.
verification_acceptance: T: offline vendor-absent first import, controlled edit, source export and independent reopen; complete semantic/dependency inventory and round-trip comparisons.

requirement: ESATAN imports shall reconstruct required case, property, GMM/TMM mapping, and user-logic data, using source-access bridges only where needed for extraction/exchange.
verification_acceptance: T: core cases execute on the owned engine at Q1; remaining mandatory runtime semantics close at Q2 against source comparisons.

requirement: All source units, node classes/numbers, submodels, frames, normals, active sides, properties, tables, and expressions shall map explicitly.
verification_acceptance: T: semantic fixtures including collisions, offsets, and front/back surfaces.

requirement: Native parsers shall implement documented, versioned dialects and diagnose unknown syntax with source location.
verification_acceptance: T: grammar, malformed-input, and future-field tests.

requirement: Legacy user code shall be preserved without automatic execution; translation shall require specified semantics and regression evidence.
verification_acceptance: T/I: executable content inert on import; translated procedures match reference cases.

requirement: Source export shall write a new project tree and preserve or explicitly reject unknown source content; overwriting originals requires separately authorized action.
verification_acceptance: T: interrupted export leaves originals unchanged and reports every unsupported field.

requirement: Each claimed source round trip shall reopen and run in the exact declared source configuration and meet semantic/numerical acceptance.
verification_acceptance: T: source→FCST→source fixtures with dependency and runtime manifests.

requirement: TD↔ESATAN exchange shall be qualified separately in both directions for the declared common semantic profile.
verification_acceptance: T: paired cross-tool fixtures and explicit unsupported-feature reports.

requirement: STEP-TAS reader/writer shall correctly parse and emit required datasets against the pinned schema, preserving their thermal data and diagnosing unsupported content.
verification_acceptance: T: source-generated files import, exported files reopen in target tools, and malformed datasets report actionable errors.

requirement: Published STEP-TAS support shall identify tested entities, dataset types, versions and directions without implying support for untested content.
verification_acceptance: I/T: capability matrix matches actual conversion fixtures and results.

requirement: Vendor runtime, compiler, API, and license prerequisites shall be discovered and reported before a bridge operation.
verification_acceptance: T: absent/mismatched runtimes fail before source mutation.

requirement: TD/SINDA product import/export shall use independently deployable open-source adapters; proprietary runtime bridges shall be optional external reference tools and shall not satisfy product import/export acceptance.
verification_acceptance: I/T: isolated offline import/edit/export/reopen with vendor installations, assemblies, license services and conversion servers absent; attempted vendor calls fail the test.

requirement: Required source results shall retain time grids, identity, quantity, units, sign convention, and interpolation provenance.
verification_acceptance: T: direct result-query and plotted-data comparisons.

requirement: All mandatory legacy-corpus features shall achieve owned-engine execution plus tested editing/re-export where required before the full backward-compatibility and solver-independence target is complete.
verification_acceptance: T/I: zero unresolved required entities/cases; required solves run without external thermal solvers and all required round trips pass.

requirement: Source-version changes and adapter upgrades shall trigger targeted requalification; previous compatibility evidence shall remain immutable.
verification_acceptance: T/I: release/profile dependency and regression audit.

requirement: Source fixture redistribution rights and any external converter restrictions shall be recorded; restricted fixtures shall be reproducibly testable in controlled infrastructure.
verification_acceptance: I/T: public synthetic and restricted reference suites both have runnable manifests.

requirement: Q1 shall support STEP-TAS entities and dataset types needed by mandatory TD and ESATAN fixtures for their required import/export operations.
verification_acceptance: T: actual source files and changed-model round trips pass; a fixed unrelated conformance-class checklist is not required.

requirement: Editable compatibility shall include changed-model round trips with controlled edits to loads, material tables, geometry/topology, properties, and cases in each required ecosystem.
verification_acceptance: T: FCST edits match equivalent source-native edits; reopen/run verifies intended changes and unchanged content preservation.

requirement: The workbench shall provide editors for nodes, surfaces, materials/optics, conductors, loads, environments, cases, and solver settings.
verification_acceptance: D/T: reference model built entirely through GUI and saved/reopened.

requirement: Analysts shall inspect geometry-to-node mappings, normals, material axes, contact links, and unassigned entities in 3D and tabular views.
verification_acceptance: D/T: deliberately wrong assignments are visible and selectable.

requirement: Results shall include temperature contours, time histories, heat-flow budgets, heater duty cycles, and boundary/energy balances with units and validity status.
verification_acceptance: T/D: displayed values match machine-readable results.

requirement: A case manager shall support hot/cold, operating/nonoperating, BOL/EOL, test/flight, variants, and parameter sweeps without duplicating source identity.
verification_acceptance: T: case differences are explicit and reproducible.

requirement: Correlation shall import sensor/time data with uncertainty and mappings, retain the uncorrelated baseline, and record parameter bounds and change rationale.
verification_acceptance: T: reproduce a synthetic test campaign and holdout comparison.

requirement: Reports shall include assumptions, provenance, conversion losses, convergence, uncertainty, configured limits, defects, and model limitations.
verification_acceptance: I/T: every plot/table traces to a run and immutable model revision.

requirement: User-defined allowable temperatures and margins shall be editable, versioned inputs.
verification_acceptance: T: changing a configured limit updates affected result checks.

requirement: Import/mesh/radiation/solve/correlation/export jobs shall expose progress, cancellation, diagnostics, and recoverable completion state.
verification_acceptance: T: cancel, restart, disconnect, and resume scenarios.

requirement: All mutating operations shall use optimistic revision checks and durable actor/project-scoped idempotency keys, rejecting different-payload key reuse and separating preview from apply keys.
verification_acceptance: T: retries across restarts do not duplicate entities/jobs; payload conflicts and stale revisions fail atomically.

requirement: Operations shall publish input/output schemas, units, capabilities, and stable diagnostic codes.
verification_acceptance: T: malformed, nonfinite, unknown-field, and unsupported-operation cases reject safely.

requirement: Multi-entity changes shall support preview, validation, atomic apply, and undo to a known committed state.
verification_acceptance: T: partial failure changes no committed entities.

requirement: Long operations shall use persistent jobs with status, progress, diagnostics, cancellation, and completion artifacts.
verification_acceptance: T: RPC timeout/disconnect never implies solve success or destroys a completed job record.

requirement: Native GUI, batch, and MCP workflows shall yield the same model semantics and numerical acceptance outcomes.
verification_acceptance: T: end-to-end parity fixture suite.

requirement: Job state, snapshot binding, atomic artifact publication, cancellation deadlines, recovery, and result-application guards shall follow the specified lifecycle.
verification_acceptance: T: interrupted/retried jobs cannot publish false success or attach results to a different model revision.

requirement: A local stdio MCP server shall expose the shared typed application operations without requiring a cloud provider.
verification_acceptance: D/T: offline local-client workflow completes a model and solve.

requirement: Supported MCP revision, lifecycle, transports, and optional extensions shall be declared and protocol-tested.
verification_acceptance: T: selected current and any legacy client profiles pass separately.

requirement: Routine modeling shall not require arbitrary Python, shell, or compiled-code execution tools.
verification_acceptance: D/I: reference workflows use only typed tools.

requirement: AI actions shall operate within a user-authorized project/case scope with bounded filesystem and compute permissions.
verification_acceptance: T: cross-project, out-of-root, and over-budget actions are rejected.

requirement: Ordinary reversible edits shall be permitted under standing authorization; external disclosure, source overwrite, and privileged legacy code execution shall require the corresponding user permission.
verification_acceptance: T/I: policy tests distinguish routine edits from consequential actions.

requirement: Imported comments, filenames, code, solver logs, and retrieved text shall remain untrusted data and cannot change automation policy.
verification_acceptance: T: prompt-injection fixtures cannot alter permissions or release evidence.

requirement: Automation logs shall record actor, model/provider identifier where known, tool/version, arguments or redacted hashes, revisions, changes, and outcomes without requiring hidden model reasoning.
verification_acceptance: T/I: an assisted session is replayable and attributable.

requirement: AI shall not falsify conversion/solver status, hide unsupported content, or retrospectively change test criteria to relabel a failure as a pass.
verification_acceptance: T: status and criteria-change checks preserve actual test/run outcomes.

requirement: Tool responses shall return bounded structured data with UUIDs and artifact references; screenshots shall be explicit.
verification_acceptance: T: large-model query pagination and response-limit tests.

requirement: Application-level job cancellation shall work independently of MCP transport cancellation or optional task extensions.
verification_acceptance: T: interrupt/disconnect/cancel tests preserve correct job state.

requirement: Any optional network MCP endpoint shall require explicit enablement, authentication, authorization, and origin/transport controls appropriate to the pinned protocol.
verification_acceptance: T/I: default installation opens no network listener; enabled profile passes security tests.

requirement: Imports shall not automatically execute macros, Python, Fortran or C/C++ user routines, shell commands, or external includes.
verification_acceptance: T: malicious source packages remain inert during inspection/conversion.

requirement: Parsers shall limit size, nesting, recursion, archive expansion, entity counts, paths, and resource use.
verification_acceptance: T: fuzzing and adversarial archive/parser corpus.

requirement: Legacy-code and third-party converter execution shall be isolated with explicit input/output roots, limits, and recorded authorization.
verification_acceptance: T/I: external access and execution-boundary tests.

requirement: The product shall work without external connectivity and disclose any optional data transmission before it occurs.
verification_acceptance: T: network-denied native workflow; transmission-policy tests.

requirement: Logs and evidence shall protect secrets and preserve actionable provenance; credentials shall not be embedded in model packages.
verification_acceptance: I/T: redaction and portable-package inspection.

requirement: Releases shall publish source, build instructions, dependency and license inventories, hashes, supported file versions, and known limitations.
verification_acceptance: I/T: clean build and installed-package verification.

requirement: Host, engine, mesher, adapter, and vendor configurations shall be independently versioned and supported in a published matrix.
verification_acceptance: T/I: every claimed matrix row has regression evidence.

requirement: Updates shall be deliberate and reversible; saved projects shall declare minimum readers and migration paths.
verification_acceptance: T: offline installation, rollback, and old-project migration fixtures.

requirement: Material and optical libraries shall record provenance, validity ranges, uncertainty, and redistribution rights.
verification_acceptance: I/T: no unlicensed proprietary library is silently bundled.

requirement: Analytical/manufactured cases, conservation, refinement, and independent code comparisons shall qualify each implemented physics module.
verification_acceptance: T/A: approved benchmark reports with build and input hashes.

requirement: Numerical criteria shall be specified per quantity, case, and use domain before results are assessed.
verification_acceptance: I/T: threshold provenance and pass/fail replay.

requirement: Both required source ecosystems shall supply original projects, dependency closures, source-tool results, and execution manifests alongside distinct owned-engine comparison runs.
verification_acceptance: I/T: native and external reference results reproducibly rerun with separate backend/mode labels.

requirement: Every claimed compatibility profile shall pass semantic inventory, unchanged and controlled-edit source round trips, and applicable numerical comparisons.
verification_acceptance: T: all mandatory fixtures pass without unapproved semantic loss, including preservation of untouched content.

requirement: The correlation workflow shall preserve measurement mappings, selected parameters, baseline predictions, and comparison results.
verification_acceptance: T: reproduce a supplied synthetic or measured dataset; measured test data is not a prerequisite for every file-compatibility profile.

requirement: Regression shall cover GUI, CLI, MCP, serialization, migrations, and supported platforms/configurations.
verification_acceptance: T: release matrix linked to immutable results.

requirement: Defects shall have severity, affected versions/features, workarounds, resolution evidence, and release disposition.
verification_acceptance: I: no unaccepted critical qualification-impacting defect at release.

requirement: All required Q2 legacy profiles and advanced behavior shall pass owned-engine solve tests and the same comparison/round-trip checks as Q1 profiles.
verification_acceptance: T/I: full-corpus report covers both ecosystems and required advanced cases; external solves cannot substitute for native completion.

requirement: Stochastic qualification shall use a predeclared statistical policy with fixed seed ensembles, replicate/sample counts, estimator/coverage, significance/multiplicity handling, and practical effect thresholds.
verification_acceptance: T/A: ensemble assessment, convergence, and investigated outliers; selective reruns cannot replace failed evidence.

requirement: Native solver acceptance shall verify that owned-engine results were generated without an external thermal solver, alongside analytical and independent-source comparisons.
verification_acceptance: T/I: isolated native test environment and backend provenance distinguish owned, reference, and fallback results.

requirement: The benchmark plan shall explicitly include SINDA and Thermal Desktop/RadCAD core comparisons, alongside existing ESATAN checks, with versioned inputs, settings and expected outputs.
verification_acceptance: T/I: applicable Q1 thermal/radiation/environment benchmarks compare owned-engine and source results under predefined tolerances.

requirement: Required fluid and coupled thermal-fluid features shall include FLUINT/FloCAD comparison cases executed independently on the owned engine.
verification_acceptance: T/A: mandatory Q2 flow/pressure/temperature/energy and relevant advanced-case comparisons pass; source execution alone cannot close native support.

requirement: Performance claims shall name hardware, configuration, input hashes, workload, accuracy settings, and peak memory.
verification_acceptance: T/I: repeatable benchmark harness and raw results.

requirement: Large-model APIs and results shall use bounded/paged/streamed access and avoid mandatory dense radiation matrices.
verification_acceptance: T/A: scaling and memory profiles at declared reference sizes.

requirement: The approved reference configuration shall meet or explicitly disposition the frozen performance targets without weakening physics tolerances.
verification_acceptance: T/I: performance report and accepted deviations separate from correctness.
